meaning_en: to think carefully about something before making a decision
example: Please consider all the options carefully before you make a final decision.
example_cn: 请在做出最终决定前仔细考虑所有选项。

meaning_en: to make something do what you want or keep it in order
example: Good teachers control the classroom without ever raising their voices.
example_cn: 好老师不用大声喊也能管住课堂。

meaning_en: to keep happening or doing something without stopping
example: We will continue the discussion after a short coffee break.
example_cn: 我们会在短暂茶歇之后继续讨论。

meaning_en: to come into sight, or to seem to be a particular way
example: A bright rainbow began to appear above the hills after the storm.
example_cn: 暴风雨过后，一道明亮的彩虹开始出现在山丘上方。

meaning_en: to say something is true without providing proof
example: He continues to claim that he witnessed the accident, though nobody believes him.
example_cn: 他仍声称自己目击了那场事故，尽管没有人相信他。

meaning_en: to grow gradually, or to make something new and better over time
example: The company plans to develop several new products for young customers.
example_cn: 公司计划为年轻顾客开发几款新产品。

meaning_en: to agree to take something that is offered to you
example: She finally decided to accept the job offer in Shanghai.
example_cn: 她最终决定接受上海的那份工作邀请。

meaning_en: to have something inside or as a part of something
example: This bottle can contain up to two litres of fresh water.
example_cn: 这个瓶子最多可以装两升淡水。

meaning_en: to plan and draw how something will look or work before it is made
example: Our team will design a new website for the local library.
example_cn: 我们团队将为当地图书馆设计一个新网站。

meaning_en: make an effort to do something difficult
example: She decided to attempt the marathon despite her recent knee injury.
example_cn: 尽管膝盖最近受伤，她还是决定尝试跑马拉松。

meaning_en: to ask someone for money for goods or services
example: Many hotels charge extra for breakfast served in your own room.
example_cn: 许多酒店对送到房间的早餐额外收费。

meaning_en: to communicate with somebody, especially by phone or email
example: I will contact the manager tomorrow about the new project schedule.
example_cn: 我明天会就新项目的进度联系经理。

meaning_en: to control or manage something, or to show somebody the way
example: She will direct the school play for the third year running.
example_cn: 她将连续第三年执导学校的戏剧演出。

meaning_en: keep away from someone or something, or prevent it happening
example: We left home early to avoid the heavy morning traffic downtown.
example_cn: 我们早早出门，以避开市中心早高峰的拥堵。

meaning_en: to say what somebody or something is like by giving details
example: Could you describe the man you saw near the station last night?
example_cn: 你能描述一下昨晚在车站附近看到的那个男人吗？

meaning_en: to make a formal request, or to put something to a practical use
example: You should apply for the scholarship before the end of this month.
example_cn: 你应该在本月底之前申请这项奖学金。

meaning_en: to talk about something with other people in order to share ideas
example: We often discuss our weekend plans at lunch on Friday.
example_cn: 我们常在周五午饭时讨论周末的安排。

meaning_en: to need somebody or something for support, or to be decided by something else
example: Whether we go hiking tomorrow will depend on the weather report.
example_cn: 我们明天是否去远足将取决于天气预报。

meaning_en: to officially agree to or accept something as good or right
example: The committee will approve the new budget at tomorrow's meeting.
example_cn: 委员会将在明天的会议上批准新预算。

meaning_en: to successfully reach a goal through effort and hard work
example: He worked hard for years to achieve his dream of teaching.
example_cn: 他多年努力，实现了当老师的梦想。

meaning_en: cause someone or something to come closer or show interest
example: Bright colours attract insects that help pollinate the flowers in spring.
example_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引昆虫，帮助春天的花朵授粉。

meaning_en: to give money, help or ideas to something useful
example: Many local people contribute money and clothes to the charity.
example_cn: 许多当地人向这家慈善机构捐钱和衣物。

meaning_en: to ask for something firmly because you believe you deserve it
example: The workers demand better pay and safer working conditions now.
example_cn: 工人们现在要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

meaning_en: to decide something officially, or to find out the facts about it
example: The judges will determine the winner after the final race today.
example_cn: 评委们将在今天的决赛后决定获胜者。

meaning_en: have enough money or resources to pay for something
example: We cannot afford a new car this year because of rising prices.
example_cn: 由于物价上涨，我们今年买不起新车。

meaning_en: to officially forbid something by law or rule
example: The city decided to ban cars from the historic centre.
example_cn: 该市决定禁止汽车进入历史城区。

meaning_en: to give somebody a job and pay them for their work
example: Large firms employ thousands of workers in this region every year.
example_cn: 大型企业每年在这个地区雇用数千名工人。

meaning_en: to give reasons for or against something in speech
example: They often argue about money, but they never stay angry long.
example_cn: 他们经常为钱争吵，但从不会生气太久。

meaning_en: to think that something is true without having any proof
example: We assume the train will arrive on time, though delays are common.
example_cn: 我们假定火车会准点到达，尽管晚点是常有的事。

meaning_en: to separate something into two or more parts
example: Teachers often divide the class into small groups for reading practice.
example_cn: 老师们常常把班级分成小组进行阅读练习。

meaning_en: to be grateful for something, or to recognize its true value
example: I really appreciate all the help you gave me during that hard week.
example_cn: 我非常感激你在那个艰难的一周里给我的所有帮助。

meaning_en: to take goods or letters to a place or person
example: The postman will deliver your heavy parcel before noon tomorrow.
example_cn: 邮递员明天中午前会把你的重包裹送到。

meaning_en: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or works
example: The heavy floods could destroy hundreds of homes in that village.
example_cn: 这场大洪水可能摧毁那个村庄数百户人家。

meaning_en: to make certain that something happens or is true
example: Please ensure that all the windows are closed before you leave.
example_cn: 离开之前请确保所有的窗户都已关好。

meaning_en: decide that a planned event or arrangement will not happen
example: They had to cancel the outdoor wedding because a violent storm was approaching.
example_cn: 因为一场猛烈暴风雨即将来临，他们不得不取消户外婚礼。

meaning_en: to make somebody believe that something is true
example: He tried hard to convince his parents that the plan was safe.
example_cn: 他努力说服父母这个计划是安全的。

meaning_en: make a public or official statement about something important
example: The company will announce its quarterly results at a press conference.
example_cn: 公司将在新闻发布会上公布季度业绩。

meaning_en: to take something from someone and return it later
example: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning, please?
example_cn: 我能借用你的伞到明天早上吗？

meaning_en: to give somebody confidence or hope to do something
example: Good teachers always encourage students to ask questions in class.
example_cn: 好老师总是鼓励学生在课堂上提问。

meaning_en: to say that someone is responsible for a fault
example: You should not blame the driver for the sudden road closure.
example_cn: 你不该因为道路突然封闭而责怪司机。

meaning_en: to plan or organize something in advance for a purpose
example: I will arrange a meeting with the client for next week.
example_cn: 我会安排下周与客户见面。

meaning_en: determine the amount or number of something using mathematics
example: Engineers calculate the load each beam can safely support before construction begins.
example_cn: 工程师们在施工开始前计算每根梁能安全承受的荷载。

meaning_en: to become smaller or weaker, or to refuse politely
example: Sales of the old phone began to decline sharply last year.
example_cn: 去年这款旧手机的销量开始急剧下降。

meaning_en: to show something to people so they can see it
example: The museum will display ancient pottery from the Han dynasty next month.
example_cn: 博物馆下个月将展出汉代的古代陶器。

meaning_en: to fall down suddenly, or to fail completely
example: The wooden bridge might collapse if too many heavy trucks cross it.
example_cn: 如果有太多重型卡车通过，这座木桥可能会坍塌。

meaning_en: to change your behaviour to suit a new situation
example: It took him months to adapt to the cold northern winter.
example_cn: 他花了几个月才适应北方寒冷的冬天。

meaning_en: change something slightly, or make it different in some way
example: A small change in diet can alter your mood and energy levels.
example_cn: 饮食上的小改变就能改变你的情绪和精力水平。

meaning_en: to be owned by someone or be a proper part of something
example: These old photographs belong to my grandmother's family album.
example_cn: 这些旧照片属于我祖母的家庭相册。

meaning_en: to fasten or join one thing to another thing
example: Please attach the receipt to your expense report before sending it.
example_cn: 寄出之前，请把收据附在你的费用报销单上。

meaning_en: to explain the exact meaning of a word or idea
example: Please define the word freedom in your own simple words.
example_cn: 请用你自己简单的话来定义自由这个词。

meaning_en: to get or obtain something, often through effort over time
example: Children acquire their first language without formal lessons at school.
example_cn: 孩子们不用在学校上正式课程就能习得母语。

meaning_en: produce a change in something or have an emotional effect on someone
example: The sudden price rise will affect millions of ordinary families.
example_cn: 价格的突然上涨将影响数百万普通家庭。

meaning_en: do something enjoyable to mark a special occasion or success
example: The whole team gathered downtown to celebrate their championship victory with a party.
example_cn: 整个队伍聚集在市中心，用一场聚会庆祝他们夺得冠军。

meaning_en: to mention something as evidence or an example
example: The researcher chose to cite three recent studies in her final report.
example_cn: 这位研究员选择在最终报告中引用三项近期研究。

meaning_en: to be made up of several different parts or things
example: The committee will consist of ten members chosen from different departments.
example_cn: 该委员会将由来自不同部门的十名成员组成。

meaning_cn: 否认；否定；拒绝；拒不承认
meaning_en: to say that something is not true or refuse a request
example: He continues to deny taking the money from the drawer.
example_cn: 他继续否认从抽屉里拿了钱。

meaning_en: to meet somebody or something unexpectedly, or to experience a difficulty
example: We often encounter many difficulties when learning a foreign language.
example_cn: 我们学习外语时常常遇到许多困难。

meaning_en: to leave someone or something behind and stop caring for it
example: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship before dawn.
example_cn: 船员们不得不在黎明前弃掉正在下沉的船。

meaning_en: to help someone do something, especially by doing part of the work
example: Two nurses assist the surgeon during every major operation in this hospital.
example_cn: 在这家医院，每台大手术都由两名护士协助外科医生。

meaning_en: to discuss a subject formally and argue different opinions
example: The students will debate the question of school uniforms today.
example_cn: 学生们今天将就校服问题展开辩论。

meaning_en: to have earned something or be worthy of it because of your actions
example: After working so hard all year, you deserve a long holiday.
example_cn: 辛苦工作了一整年，你应该好好休个长假。

meaning_en: to act in a particular way or conduct oneself properly
example: Parents often wonder how their children will behave at a formal dinner.
example_cn: 父母常想知道自己的孩子在一场正式晚宴上会如何表现。

meaning_en: to take in a liquid, gas, or other substance gradually
example: Dry soil will absorb rainwater much faster than wet clay.
example_cn: 干燥的土壤吸收雨水比湿黏土快得多。

meaning_en: move forward or help something develop further
example: Troops continued to advance through the valley despite heavy rain.
example_cn: 尽管下着大雨，部队仍继续穿过山谷向前推进。

meaning_en: to match or be similar to something else
example: These numbers correspond exactly to the figures in our report.
example_cn: 这些数字与我们报告中的数据完全吻合。

meaning_en: to win against somebody in a game, battle or election
example: Our team hopes to defeat the champions in the final match.
example_cn: 我们队希望在决赛中击败冠军。

meaning_en: to go somewhere with someone as a companion
example: Her younger brother will accompany her to the interview tomorrow morning.
example_cn: 她弟弟明天早上会陪她去面试。

meaning_en: to send out a programme on television or radio
example: The station will broadcast the match live on Saturday evening.
example_cn: 该电台将在周六晚上现场直播这场比赛。

meaning_en: to put things into groups according to shared qualities
example: Librarians classify these old maps according to region, date, and printing style.
example_cn: 图书管理员按地区、年代和印刷风格为这些旧地图分类。

meaning_en: to take part in something or to attract somebody's interest
example: Many university students engage in sports after their classes finish.
example_cn: 许多大学生下课后参加体育运动。

meaning_en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something
example: The teachers assess our progress through weekly tests and detailed written reports.
example_cn: 老师们通过每周测验和详细的书面报告来评估我们的进步。

meaning_en: to show clearly that something is true or how it works
example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the whole class.
example_cn: 老师将向全班演示这个实验。

meaning_en: examine something carefully in order to understand its parts or nature
example: Scientists will analyse the samples carefully before publishing their final report.
example_cn: 科学家们会仔细分析这些样本，然后才发表最终报告。

meaning_en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation or problem
example: She learned to cope with stress after changing her daily routine.
example_cn: 她改变日常作息之后学会了应对压力。

meaning_en: to make something happen later than the planned time
example: Heavy rain may delay our flight to Beijing this evening.
example_cn: 大雨可能会延误我们今晚飞往北京的航班。

meaning_en: to appear or come out from somewhere hidden
example: New details about the accident continue to emerge several days later.
example_cn: 事故的新细节在几天后仍不断浮现。

meaning_en: to increase or improve the quality or value of something
example: Regular exercise can greatly enhance the quality of your daily life.
example_cn: 经常锻炼能极大提高你的日常生活质量。

meaning_en: to annoy someone, or to take the trouble to do something
example: Don't let the noise bother you while you are studying.
example_cn: 你学习的时候别让噪音打扰你。

meaning_en: take something as your own or legally raise another person's child
example: The company decided to adopt a four-day working week for all staff.
example_cn: 公司决定对所有员工实行每周四天工作制。

meaning_en: to connect someone or something in your mind with another person or thing
example: Most people associate the smell of coffee with quiet mornings at home.
example_cn: 大多数人把咖啡的香气与家中安静的清晨联系在一起。

meaning_en: to give things to a number of people or places
example: Volunteers will distribute food and blankets to families after the flood.
example_cn: 洪水过后，志愿者将向受灾家庭分发食物和毯子。

meaning_en: to take someone into custody because of a crime
example: Police went to arrest the suspect at his home yesterday morning.
example_cn: 警方昨天上午去他家逮捕了嫌疑人。

meaning_en: to become or make something smaller in number or amount
example: The number of wild birds continues to decrease across the whole region.
example_cn: 整个地区野生鸟类的数量持续减少。

meaning_en: to notice or discover something that is not easy to see
example: These machines can detect tiny cracks in the metal airplane wings.
example_cn: 这些机器能探测出飞机金属机翼上的细小裂缝。

meaning_en: to succeed in doing or completing something you planned
example: The team managed to accomplish the whole project two weeks early.
example_cn: 团队设法提前两周完成了整个项目。

meaning_en: to give someone a particular job, duty, or piece of work
example: The manager will assign each new employee a mentor during the first month.
example_cn: 经理会在第一个月给每位新员工指派一位导师。

meaning_en: to give special importance to something when speaking
example: Doctors emphasize the importance of sleep for young students every year.
example_cn: 医生们每年都强调睡眠对年轻学生的重要性。

meaning_en: respect and like someone or something very much
example: I admire her courage in speaking up against the unfair rule.
example_cn: 我钦佩她敢于直言反对那条不公正规定的勇气。

meaning_en: to choose someone for an official position by voting
example: Members will elect a new chairman at the meeting next Friday.
example_cn: 成员们将在下周五的会议上选举新主席。

meaning_en: to admit that something is true or to confirm receipt
example: She refused to acknowledge her mistake in front of the class.
example_cn: 她拒绝在全班面前承认自己的错误。

meaning_en: to increase or improve something and make it more successful
example: Lower prices should boost sales in the final quarter of the year.
example_cn: 降低价格应该能提升今年最后一个季度的销售额。

meaning_cn: 保证；担保；确保；打消疑虑
meaning_en: to tell someone confidently that something is true or will happen
example: I can assure you that the repairs will be finished by Friday.
example_cn: 我可以向你保证，维修工作会在周五之前完成。

meaning_en: to decide that something or someone is not important
example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers after the serious safety incident.
example_cn: 经理在严重的安全事故后决定解雇两名工人。

meaning_en: to suffer something painful or difficult patiently over a long time
example: She had to endure great pain after the accident last year.
example_cn: 去年事故之后她不得不忍受巨大的痛苦。

meaning_en: to make something happen faster or move more quickly
example: Government policy could accelerate the shift toward clean energy.
example_cn: 政府政策可能会加快向清洁能源的转变。

meaning_en: to remove something completely or get rid of it
example: The new system should eliminate most errors in our monthly reports.
example_cn: 新系统应该能消除我们月度报告中的大部分错误。

meaning_en: to run after someone or something in order to catch them
example: The excited dog loves to chase squirrels around the park every morning.
example_cn: 那只兴奋的狗喜欢每天早上在公园里追松鼠。

meaning_en: to be unlike something or somebody else in some way
example: Their opinions differ greatly on how to spend the extra money.
example_cn: 他们在如何花这笔额外的钱上意见大不相同。

meaning_en: tell the public about a product or job in order to attract them
example: They advertise their new phone on almost every social platform.
example_cn: 他们几乎在每个社交平台上为那款新手机做广告。

meaning_en: to recognize the difference between two or more things
example: Young children often cannot distinguish between fantasy and reality very clearly.
example_cn: 幼儿常常无法很清楚地分辨幻想与现实。

meaning_en: to give your time and effort completely to something important
example: She chose to dedicate her life to helping poor children.
example_cn: 她选择把一生奉献给帮助贫困儿童。

meaning_en: change something slightly to make it more suitable or correct
example: You can adjust the height of the chair to suit your desk.
example_cn: 你可以调整椅子的高度，好配合你的书桌。

meaning_en: to control or have power over someone or something
example: One large company continues to dominate the local mobile phone market.
example_cn: 一家大公司继续主导着当地的手机市场。

meaning_en: to make something look more attractive by adding things to it
example: We will decorate the living room with flowers before the party.
example_cn: 我们会在聚会前用鲜花装饰客厅。

meaning_en: surprise someone very much in an impressive or unexpected way
example: The magician's final trick continued to amaze the entire audience.
example_cn: 魔术师最后的戏法让全场观众惊叹不已。

meaning_en: to bring people or parts together into one group
example: Workers assemble the cars from parts made in several countries.
example_cn: 工人们用来自几个国家的零件组装汽车。

meaning_en: to make somebody sad because something was not as good as hoped
example: I really don't want to disappoint my parents with such low grades.
example_cn: 我真不想用这么差的成绩让父母失望。

meaning_en: publicly support an idea or plan and argue for it
example: Doctors advocate regular exercise as the best way to stay healthy.
example_cn: 医生提倡把规律锻炼当作保持健康的最佳方式。

meaning_en: to be disloyal to someone who trusts you
example: He would never betray a friend for money or promotion.
example_cn: 他绝不会为了金钱或升职而背叛朋友。

meaning_en: stop happening or doing something, especially for a period
example: The heavy rain will cease at dawn, so the match can start.
example_cn: 大雨终于在黎明时停止，因此比赛被取消了。

meaning_cn: 令人十分惊讶；使人震惊
meaning_en: to surprise someone very much with something unexpected
example: The boy's sudden talent for chess seemed to astonish everyone at the club.
example_cn: 这个男孩突然展现的象棋天赋似乎让俱乐部的每个人都大为惊讶。

meaning_en: a record of money or a written description of events
example: She opened a savings account at the bank near her office.
example_cn: 她在办公室附近的银行开了一个储蓄账户。

meaning_en: the qualities that make a person or place distinct
example: The main character in this novel is a brave young village teacher.
example_cn: 这部小说的主角是一位勇敢的年轻乡村教师。

meaning_en: the power or skill needed to do something well
example: Her ability to stay calm impressed everyone during the crisis.
example_cn: 她在危机中保持冷静的能力让所有人印象深刻。

meaning_en: the right or opportunity to enter or use something
example: Students need a valid card to gain access to the library after dark.
example_cn: 学生们需要有效证件才能在夜间进入图书馆。

meaning_en: something difficult that tests your ability or determination
example: Learning a new language is a challenge that many people genuinely enjoy.
example_cn: 学习一门新语言是许多人真心喜欢的挑战。

meaning_en: a way of dealing with something, or the act of coming nearer
example: The teacher tried a completely new approach to help weaker students improve.
example_cn: 这位老师尝试了一种全新的方法来帮助较弱的学生提高。

meaning_en: how much there is of something, or a total sum
example: A large amount of money was spent on repairing the old bridge.
example_cn: 修缮这座旧桥花了一大笔钱。

meaning_en: the way a person thinks or feels about something
example: His positive attitude helped the whole group get through a tough week.
example_cn: 他积极的态度帮助整个团队度过了艰难的一周。

meaning_en: harm that makes something less useful or valuable
example: The storm caused serious damage to several houses near the coast.
example_cn: 暴风雨对海岸附近的几所房屋造成了严重损坏。

meaning_en: an advantage or profit gained from something
example: Regular exercise brings a lasting benefit to both body and mind.
example_cn: 经常锻炼对身心都有持久的益处。

meaning_en: an unfortunate event that happens unexpectedly and causes damage
example: The traffic accident near the bridge delayed hundreds of commuters this morning.
example_cn: 桥附近的交通事故今早让数百名通勤者延误了。

meaning_en: a fact or condition that affects a situation or event
example: Under no circumstance should you open that door alone.
example_cn: 在困难的境况下，人们往往会显露出真实的品格和内在的力量。

meaning_en: a state in which weight or forces are evenly distributed
example: Losing her balance on the icy path, she grabbed the railing.
example_cn: 在结冰的小路上失去平衡时，她一把抓住了栏杆。

meaning_en: the job or series of jobs a person does during working life
example: He gave up a stable banking career to open a small bakery.
example_cn: 他放弃了稳定的银行业职业，去开一家小面包店。

meaning_en: the main principle or foundation on which something rests
example: Their friendship rests on a basis of complete mutual trust.
example_cn: 他们的友谊建立在完全相互信任的基础之上。

meaning_en: the power to give orders or make official decisions
example: The local authority finally approved plans for a new public library.
example_cn: 当地当局最终批准了新建公共图书馆的计划。

meaning_en: a prize given to someone for an achievement or victory
example: The young scientist received an award for her research on clean energy.
example_cn: 这位年轻科学家因清洁能源研究而获奖。

meaning_en: organized series of actions intended to achieve a particular result
example: The charity launched a nationwide campaign to improve rural children's access to clean water.
example_cn: 该慈善机构发起了一场全国性运动，以改善农村儿童获得清洁水的条件。

meaning_en: a substance produced by or used in chemistry
example: Farmers here use far less chemical on their crops than before.
example_cn: 这里的农民在庄稼上使用的化学品比以前少得多。

meaning_en: one part or feature of a situation, idea, or problem
example: We must consider every aspect of the plan before signing it.
example_cn: 签字之前，我们必须考虑这个计划的每个方面。

meaning_en: something that blocks movement or prevents progress
example: Language remains the biggest barrier for many new immigrants.
example_cn: 对许多新移民来说，语言仍是最大的障碍。

meaning_en: a plan of how much money you can spend
example: Our monthly budget leaves little room for eating out.
example_cn: 我们每月的预算几乎没有外出就餐的余地。

meaning_en: something that helps you or puts you in a better position
example: Speaking two languages gives her a real advantage at work.
example_cn: 会说两种语言让她在工作中拥有真正的优势。

meaning_en: the line dividing two countries or areas
example: They crossed the border into France just before midnight.
example_cn: 他们在午夜前越过边界进入法国。

meaning_en: the state of being away from a place or person
example: His long absence from class worried all of his teachers.
example_cn: 他长期缺课让所有老师都很担心。

meaning_en: the maximum amount that something can contain or produce
example: The new stadium has a seating capacity of about sixty thousand people.
example_cn: 这座新体育场的座位容量约为六万人。

meaning_en: the central and most important part of something
example: Honesty lies at the very core of every good friendship.
example_cn: 诚实是每一段良好友谊的核心。

meaning_en: a quality that attracts people, or a serious request for help
example: The charity launched an urgent appeal to raise money for homeless families.
example_cn: 这家慈善机构发起了紧急呼吁，为无家可归的家庭筹款。

meaning_en: person who is applying for a job or competing for a position
example: Each candidate for the teaching post must give a short demonstration lesson.
example_cn: 每位申请该教职的候选人都必须上一节简短的示范课。

meaning_en: a television station or a way of communicating information
example: This television channel broadcasts the evening news in three different languages.
example_cn: 这个电视频道用三种不同的语言播报晚间新闻。

meaning_en: a person who has won a competition or fights for a cause
example: She became the world champion after training hard for almost ten years.
example_cn: 经过近十年的刻苦训练，她成为了世界冠军。

meaning_en: a feeling of not being certain about something
example: There is real doubt about whether the project can finish on time.
example_cn: 关于这个项目能否按时完成，确实存在疑问。

meaning_en: a main division of a book or a period in history
example: I read the first chapter twice because the story was so gripping.
example_cn: 我把第一章读了两遍，因为故事太扣人心弦了。

meaning_en: a formal public event held to mark an important occasion
example: The graduation ceremony lasted nearly three hours and made everyone quite emotional.
example_cn: 毕业典礼持续了将近三个小时，让每个人都十分激动。

meaning_en: the art or study of designing buildings and other structures
example: She studied architecture in Rome and now designs public libraries.
example_cn: 她在罗马学习建筑学，现在设计公共图书馆。

meaning_en: the mixture of gases around the earth, or the mood of a place
example: The candlelit restaurant had a warm, romantic atmosphere that pleased every guest.
example_cn: 这家烛光餐厅有着温暖浪漫的氛围，令每位客人都感到愉悦。

meaning_en: an organization that helps people in need
example: The charity provides free meals to homeless people every single night.
example_cn: 该慈善机构每天晚上为无家可归的人提供免费餐食。

meaning_en: a heavy load or a difficult duty you must bear
example: Caring for three children alone is a heavy burden for her.
example_cn: 独自照顾三个孩子对她来说是沉重的负担。

meaning_en: a strong desire to achieve success or reach a particular goal
example: Her greatest ambition is to become a doctor and help poor families.
example_cn: 她最大的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助贫困家庭。

meaning_en: an early version of a piece of writing or plan
example: She emailed the first draft of her report to the editor.
example_cn: 她把报告的第一稿通过电子邮件发给了编辑。

meaning_en: the way people from a place pronounce words
example: After ten years in Texas he still had a slight accent.
example_cn: 在得州待了十年后，他说话仍带一点口音。

meaning_en: a wide street in a town, or a way of achieving something
example: They strolled along a quiet avenue lined with old maple trees.
example_cn: 他们沿着一条两旁长满老枫树的安静大街漫步。

meaning_en: the practice and science of farming, including crops and livestock
example: Agriculture remains the main source of income for people in this region.
example_cn: 在这一地区，农业仍是人们主要的收入来源。

meaning_en: an exciting and sometimes dangerous experience or journey
example: Their sailing trip across the Pacific turned into a wild adventure.
example_cn: 他们横渡太平洋的航行变成了一场狂野的冒险。

meaning_cn: 运动员；体育健儿；竞技者
meaning_en: a person who is good at sports, especially running, jumping, or throwing
example: Every athlete on the team trains for at least three hours each morning.
example_cn: 队里的每位运动员每天早上至少训练三个小时。

meaning_en: the natural desire to eat food, or a strong wish for something
example: A long walk in the cold air gave him a healthy appetite for dinner.
example_cn: 在冷空气中长时间散步让他晚餐时食欲大增。

meaning_en: the sound of many people clapping to show approval or enjoyment
example: The audience burst into loud applause as the singer left the stage.
example_cn: 歌手离开舞台时，观众爆发出响亮的掌声。

meaning_en: able to be used, obtained, or reached by someone
example: Tickets are still available online until Friday, so book yours soon.
example_cn: 网上售票持续到周五，所以请尽快预订。

meaning_en: knowing that something exists or is happening
example: Most people are now aware of how plastic waste harms ocean life.
example_cn: 现在大多数人都意识到塑料垃圾如何危害海洋生物。

meaning_en: suitable or right for a particular situation, person, or purpose
example: Jeans are hardly appropriate for such a formal job interview.
example_cn: 牛仔裤对于如此正式的求职面试来说很不合适。

meaning_cn: 学术的；学业的；纯理论的
meaning_en: relating to education, schools, or scholarly study and research
example: Her academic performance improved a lot after she joined a study group.
example_cn: 加入学习小组后，她的学业成绩提高了很多。

meaning_en: complete and total, without any limit or doubt
example: The new manager demanded absolute loyalty from every team member.
example_cn: 新经理要求每位团队成员给予绝对忠诚。

meaning_en: lasting only a short time, or using few words
example: He gave a brief talk about safety before the flight.
example_cn: 他在飞行前做了一个关于安全的简短讲话。

meaning_en: having the ability or skill needed to do something well
example: She is perfectly capable of managing the whole department without any outside help.
example_cn: 她完全有能力在没有外界帮助的情况下管理整个部门。

meaning_cn: 每年的；年度的；一年一次的
meaning_en: happening once every year, or relating to a single year
example: The school holds its annual sports meeting in early October.
example_cn: 学校每年十月初举行运动会。

meaning_en: easy to see or understand, or seeming true but possibly not real
example: It soon became apparent that nobody had read the instructions carefully.
example_cn: 很快就可以看出，没有人仔细读过说明。

meaning_cn: 准确的；精确的；正确无误的
meaning_en: correct and exact in every detail, without any mistakes
example: The weather forecast proved surprisingly accurate for the whole weekend.
example_cn: 这个天气预报整个周末都出乎意料地准确。

meaning_cn: 古代的；古老的；年代久远的
meaning_en: belonging to a period of history long ago; very old
example: We wandered through the ancient streets of the town at sunrise.
example_cn: 日出时我们漫步在这座小镇古老的街道上。

meaning_en: extremely clever, impressive, or bright in colour
example: Her brilliant performance won praise from every critic in town.
example_cn: 她出色的表演赢得了城里每位评论家的赞扬。

meaning_en: feeling worried and nervous, or very eager for something
example: She felt anxious about the exam results and could not sleep that night.
example_cn: 她为考试成绩感到焦虑，那晚无法入睡。

meaning_en: causing embarrassment, or moving in a clumsy and ungraceful way
example: There was an awkward silence after he mentioned her previous job.
example_cn: 他提到她以前的工作后，出现了尴尬的沉默。

meaning_cn: 抽象的；理论上的；深奥的
meaning_en: existing as an idea rather than as a physical object
example: Young children find abstract ideas like justice quite hard to grasp.
example_cn: 幼儿觉得正义这类抽象概念相当难以理解。

meaning_en: having no writing, marks, or expression
example: She stared at the blank page, unsure how to begin her essay.
example_cn: 她盯着空白的纸页，不知如何下笔写这篇文章。

meaning_en: made by people rather than occurring naturally in the world
example: The lake looks natural, but it is actually a large artificial pool.
example_cn: 这个湖看上去很自然，但实际上是一个大型人工水池。

meaning_en: having a sharp unpleasant taste or feeling resentful and hurt
example: The medicine left a bitter taste that lingered all afternoon.
example_cn: 这药留下了一股整个下午都挥之不去的苦味。

meaning_en: based on personal choice or chance rather than reason
example: The decision seemed completely arbitrary and no one could explain it.
example_cn: 这个决定似乎完全是随意的，没人能解释清楚。

meaning_cn: 足够的；适当的；能胜任的
meaning_en: enough in quantity or good enough in quality for a purpose
example: The room was small but adequate for a single traveler.
example_cn: 这个房间不大，但供一位独自旅行的人住已经足够了。

meaning_cn: 大约的；近似的；不精确的
meaning_en: close to a particular number or amount but not exact
example: The approximate cost of the repairs is around three hundred pounds.
example_cn: 这些维修的大致费用在三百英镑左右。

meaning_en: careful to avoid possible danger, mistakes or risks
example: Investors remained cautious about putting more money into the rapidly changing market.
example_cn: 投资者对向这个快速变化的市场投入更多资金仍持谨慎态度。

meaning_en: used to say what is true in fact
example: The movie was actually much better than I expected it to be.
example_cn: 这部电影实际上比我预想的要好得多。

meaning_en: in a way that is easy to understand
example: He clearly explained all the rules before the game started yesterday.
example_cn: 昨天比赛开始前，他清楚地讲解了所有规则。

meaning_en: used to agree strongly or say something is true
example: This is certainly the best meal I have eaten all year.
example_cn: 这无疑是我一整年吃过的最好的一顿饭。

meaning_en: more than usual, or above all others
example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in the summer.
example_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橙子。

meaning_en: in every way; totally and fully
example: The old building was completely destroyed by the fire last night.
example_cn: 那座老建筑昨晚被大火彻底烧毁了。

meaning_en: in a straight line or without anything between
example: The train goes directly from the airport to the city centre.
example_cn: 这趟列车从机场直达市中心。

meaning_en: in a complete way, without any doubt
example: I absolutely agree with every single point that you just made.
example_cn: 我完全同意你刚才提出的每一点。

meaning_en: at the present time or moment
example: The project is currently under review by the planning committee.
example_cn: 该项目目前正在接受规划委员会的审查。

meaning_en: without doubt, in a clear and certain way
example: She definitely plans to attend the important meeting tomorrow morning.
example_cn: 她肯定打算参加明天上午的重要会议。

meaning_en: in a way that shows attention and thought
example: She carefully checked every number in the report before sending it.
example_cn: 报告寄出前，她仔细核对了报告中的每一个数字。

meaning_en: at the end of a long period of time
example: After many delays, the flight eventually left the airport at midnight.
example_cn: 经过多次延误，航班最终在午夜离开了机场。

meaning_en: as it seems from what you have heard
example: Apparently, the meeting has been moved to next Friday morning.
example_cn: 据说会议已改到下周五上午。

meaning_en: completely and in every possible way
example: I entirely agree with your opinion about the new plan.
example_cn: 我完全同意你对新计划的看法。

meaning_en: in a way that produces the intended result
example: The new manager effectively solved the problem within two weeks.
example_cn: 新经理在两周内有效地解决了这个问题。

meaning_en: all the time; again and again
example: He constantly checks his phone during every meeting at work.
example_cn: 他每次开会时都不停地看手机。

meaning_en: in the main or most important ways
example: The plan is basically the same as the one we discussed.
example_cn: 这个计划基本上和我们讨论过的那个一样。

meaning_en: in the same amount, degree, or manner
example: The two teams played equally well during the whole match.
example_cn: 整场比赛中，两支球队表现得同样出色。

meaning_en: in the most important or basic way
example: The two designs are essentially the same in every detail.
example_cn: 这两个设计在每一个细节上基本上是相同的。

meaning_en: for a short time or in few words
example: She spoke briefly about her plans for the coming year.
example_cn: 她简短地谈了自己来年的计划。

meaning_en: in a way that is intentional and planned
example: He deliberately ignored my question and walked out of the room.
example_cn: 他故意无视我的问题，然后走出了房间。
